semantics: Dimensionless trend evidence: +1 = strongest positive trend, 0 = neutral / mixed, -1 = strongest negative trend. NOT an expected (excess or total) return, NOT a probability, NOT a portfolio weight, NOT alpha, NOT a Black-Litterman view Q.
directional_trend: mean over horizons of sign(R_h - c_h); in [-1, +1]
continuous_h: (R_h - c_h) / (sigma * sqrt(h/12)); sigma = frozen Phase 1 P1_EWMA_63 annualized sleeve volatility; c_h = realized EONIA->ESTR cash return over the same (base, t]
total_return_momentum: diagnostics/total_return_momentum.csv (DIAGNOSTIC ONLY; the v1 engine on R_h)
date_alignment: model date t = last common observed date of the calendar month (Phase 2 contract dates); base = sleeve's last own observation on or before t - h months; only data dated <= t
